Elaine: Quick follow-up from the RFC on service token minting — thinking about binding ephemeral tokens to the deployment artifact hash (sha256 of the image / model package) instead of project id. Thoughts?
Sanjay: Interesting. Main upside is tighter replay resistance — token invalidates if artifact changes. Also helps for supply-chain attestation.
Matt: Downside: what about multi-service bundles or shared libs? If two microservices use same artifact base, do we mint per-service or per-artifact? could explode key count.
Ashley: Also consider CI/CD ergonomics. Will deployers need to request a new token on every build? That's a UX/latency problem. Could do short TTL tokens + refresh on deploy. :thinking_face: 
Sanjay: TTL + refresh seems ok. Recommend refresh-as-part-of-deploy pipeline. Token contains claim: artifact_sha and service_id. Example claim payload: ```{
  "sub": "svc:payments",
  "artifact": "sha256:abc123...",
  "exp": 1714322400
}```
Matt: How do we map RBAC? If token only carries artifact hash, how do we reason about org/project scoping? We still need project scoping for billing and quotas.
Elaine: Proposal: token contains both artifact and project_id. Enforcement check is two-part: 1) project membership + role allow, 2) artifact binding match on runtime. So if artifact mismatches, revoke/deny.
Ashley: Policy engine needs to understand artifact predicates (e.g., allow service if artifact in allowlist, or deny if wildcard). Might be heavy but doable.
Sanjay: Another trade: offline verification for long-running jobs. If token exp short, must handle rotation mid-job. For long jobs we could let runtime exchange short-lived service token for ephemeral session token scoped to job with extended TTL but pinned to artifact.
Matt: Sounds like we need a token issuance flow: 
- CI builds artifact -> compute artifact_sha
- CI requests mint endpoint with service identity + artifact_sha + proof (signed by CI key)
- Mint service issues short-lived token with claims (project, artifact, nonce)
- Runtime verifies signature + artifact match at startup
Ashley: Operational note: we must surface clear telemetry: token issuances per-service, artifact->tokens mapping, revokes. Add a UI page in Console for artifact-bound tokens.
deploy-bot: deployment svc-payments/2026-03-21 succeeded; artifact sha=sha256:abc123...
Elaine: One more edge: shared runtime images (k8s daemonset) where artifact changes rarely. For that use a longer TTL or attach host identity instead. Keep default behavior per-service but allow overrides.
Matt: For implementation: prefer existing token service with an extra claim and a small policy hook. Avoid ripping out scopes now. Work in follow-up RFC for lifecycle (revocation, exchange, tooling).
Elaine: Agreed. Action items: Sanjay to draft mint endpoint shape + claims, Ashley to sketch console UI, Matt to propose RBAC policy semantics. I'll start a short RFC addendum and link this thread. :thumbsup:
